summary: The Excel Link Manager loads much faster by scanning the reserving class on the ArcRho Server instead of over the network drive.
details: Listing a reserving class's Excel links opened every dataset sidecar and DFM method file across the network drive, which cost about three seconds for a class with roughly 140 files.

That scan now runs on the ArcRho Server machine when the Gateway is available, where those files are local disk; it falls back to the previous behavior unchanged when the Gateway is off or unreachable.
Whether each linked workbook still exists is checked on your own PC, so workbooks on shares only your PC maps keep showing as Found.
Retargeting a workbook returns its refreshed inventory the same faster way.
